evidence.claim: Customer C08623 disputes transaction 3530164 ($49.00); in the bank's closed cases every customer-reported alert was confirmed fraud
Another transaction on the same account (3530056, $116.93) scored 0.88 49 minutes earlier
Model risk score 0.40 on the disputed transaction
Policy applied, Fraud Policy R2: Customer denies the transaction: Recommend BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE.
Pattern definition, Known fraud patterns: Out-of-region use: Card-present purchases in a billing region the cardholder has no history in, while their normal activity continues at home.

case.summary: The alert was triggered when customer C08623 reported that a $49.00 in-person purchase (transaction 3530164) was not made by them. The strongest findings are that the customer disputed transaction 3530164, and a prior transaction on the same account (3530056 for $116.93) occurred 49 minutes earlier with a high fraud risk score of 0.88. The case was judged to be fraud with a probability of 93 percent. The recommended actions are to block the card and to create a case for further investigation.
